scientific_integrity: The quantifiers are supported by an analytical multinomial identity, cubic-simplex extremal lemma and minimax quadratic envelope; a standalone verifier performs independent finite checks. Literature equivalence in unindexed sources cannot be ruled out, and independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic, orthogonal identity system with simultaneous iid selections, squared-current-residual probabilities and additive corrections from the same frozen snapshot. No claim for nonorthogonal or inconsistent systems, live-read updates, wall-clock speedups, or an exact long-run rate; the positive floor is only a best one-batch worst-case factor.
title: A sharp minimax relaxation and collision floor for frozen residual-weighted Kaczmarz batches
